rules: Dai sempre del Lei ai clienti nelle email.
Firma le email come "Lo staff della Tipografia Esempio".
Always sign customer emails as "The Example Studio team".
Never share internal cost breakdowns with customers.

proposed.subject: Re: Problema stampa menu
proposed.body:
Gentile Sig. Bellini,
ci dispiace per il problema con la stampa dei menu. Se preferisce, la richiamiamo noi in giornata per risolverlo.
Cordiali saluti,
Lo staff della Tipografia Esempio

edited.subject: Re: Problema stampa menu
edited.body:
Gentile Sig. Bellini,
ci dispiace per il problema con la stampa dei menu. Per l'assistenza ci scriva pure a questo indirizzo: non facciamo richiamate telefoniche, ma rispondiamo a tutte le email entro 24 ore.
Cordiali saluti,
Lo staff della Tipografia Esempio

cases.why: The user removed a callback offer and stated a standing support policy (email only, no phone callbacks), the tool description's own example of a durable rule; the rule must point customers to writing/email.

proposed.subject: Re: Printed samples
proposed.body:
Hi Priya,
your printed samples will arrive tomorrow.
Best regards,
The Example Studio team

edited.subject: Re: Printed samples
edited.body:
Hi Priya,
your printed samples are packed. As a rule we only confirm a delivery date once the courier has collected the parcel, so we'll email you the tracking number as soon as it's picked up.
Best regards,
The Example Studio team

cases.why: The edit replaces a promised delivery date with a policy the user states as general ('As a rule'): no delivery date before the courier has the parcel.

proposed.subject: Re: Modalità di pagamento
proposed.body:
Gentile cliente,
il pagamento può avvenire anche in contrassegno alla consegna.
Cordiali saluti,
Lo staff della Tipografia Esempio

edited.subject: Re: Modalità di pagamento
edited.body:
Gentile cliente,
il pagamento è solo anticipato tramite bonifico: non accettiamo il contrassegno.
Cordiali saluti,
Lo staff della Tipografia Esempio

cases.why: The user replaced an offered payment method with a general payment policy ('solo anticipato', 'non accettiamo il contrassegno') that holds for every customer.

proposed.subject: Re: Login issue
proposed.body:
Hi Sam,
sorry about the login issue. Feel free to call our support line on +44 20 0000 0456 any time.
Best regards,
The Example Studio team

edited.subject: Re: Login issue
edited.body:
Hi Sam,
sorry about the login issue. For support, please use the help form in your client area: we no longer offer phone support.
Best regards,
The Example Studio team

cases.why: A phone-support offer removed and the user states phone support no longer exists; the general replacement, the help form, is what the rule must carry.

proposed.subject: Re: Listino prezzi
proposed.body:
Buongiorno,
le allego il nostro listino prezzi completo.
Cordiali saluti,
Lo staff della Tipografia Esempio

edited.subject: Re: Listino prezzi
edited.body:
Buongiorno,
il listino prezzi lo inviamo solo ai rivenditori registrati sul nostro portale: le basta completare la registrazione e lo riceverà subito.
Cordiali saluti,
Lo staff della Tipografia Esempio

cases.why: Sending the price list replaced by a general condition ('solo ai rivenditori registrati'), a policy for every future request.

proposed.subject: Re: Delayed delivery
proposed.body:
Hi Laura,
we're sorry for the delay. As a gesture of goodwill, we can offer you 10% off your next project.
Best regards,
The Example Studio team

edited.subject: Re: Delayed delivery
edited.body:
Hi Laura,
we're sorry for the delay. Please note that we never offer discounts by email: any commercial conditions are handled by our sales team.
Best regards,
The Example Studio team

cases.why: A discount offer removed and replaced by a policy the user states as general ('we never offer discounts by email').

proposed.subject: Re: Biglietti da visita
proposed.body:
Gentile Sig.ra Rossi,
le confermiamo la spedizone dei biglietti da visita per domani.
Cordiali saluti,
Lo staff della Tipografia Esempio

edited.subject: Re: Biglietti da visita
edited.body:
Gentile Sig.ra Rossi,
le confermiamo la spedizione dei biglietti da visita per domani.
Cordiali saluti,
Lo staff della Tipografia Esempio

cases.why: A one-letter typo fix ('spedizone'); the tool description says typo fixes are never durable rules.

proposed.subject: Re: Display stands
proposed.body:
Hi Priya,
we can deliver the display stands on Friday morning.
Best regards,
The Example Studio team

edited.subject: Re: Display stands
edited.body:
Hi Priya,
we can deliver the display stands on Friday morning. As agreed with you on the phone, the driver will call you 30 minutes before arriving.
Best regards,
The Example Studio team

cases.why: The added sentence is an arrangement made with this one customer ('as agreed with you'); as a rule it would promise every customer a driver's call.

proposed.message: Grazie per l'ordine dei volantini, buona giornata!

edited.message: Grazie per l'ordine dei volantini e in bocca al lupo per l'inaugurazione del nuovo negozio! Buona giornata!

cases.why: A personal wish for this customer's shop opening; a personal detail is not a policy, and as a rule it would congratulate every customer on an opening.

proposed.subject: Final logo files
proposed.body:
Hi Tom,
the final logo files are attached.
Best regards,
Example Studio

edited.subject: Final logo files
edited.body:
Hi Tom,
the final logo files are attached.
Best regards,
The Example Studio team

cases.why: The edit only applies the existing rule 'Always sign customer emails as "The Example Studio team"'; the tool excludes anything already covered by an existing rule. Recording it would only restate a correct rule (the store routes identical or contained rules to its duplicate check), so the error is not critical.

proposed.message: Buongiorno, può ritirare i biglietti da visita martedì dalle 10 in negozio.

edited.message: Buongiorno, può ritirare i biglietti da visita mercoledì dalle 10 in negozio.

cases.why: The pickup day of one order moved from Tuesday to Wednesday, a one-off change; as a rule it would send every customer to the shop on Wednesdays.

proposed.subject: Re: Your brief
proposed.body:

we have received you're brief and it's being reviewed by the team.
Best regards,
The Example Studio team

edited.subject: Re: Your brief
edited.body:
Hello,
we have received your brief and it is being reviewed by the team.
Best regards,
The Example Studio team

cases.why: Grammar fixes only ('your', 'it is'); the tool description says grammar fixes are not durable rules.

edited.subject: Re: Preventivo biglietti da visita

per 500 biglietti da visita il prezzo è di 52 EUR + IVA, con consegna in 3 giorni lavorativi.
Cordiali saluti,
Lo staff della Tipografia Esempio

cases.why: The standard price of 500 business cards, quoted generically, corrected from 45 to 52 EUR + IVA; the existing category 'biglietti da visita' fits, and recording the old figure would be a wrong fact.

per i volantini l'ordine minimo è di 500 copie.

edited.message: Buongiorno! La spedizione in Italia costa 12,50 EUR e arriva in 48 ore.

cases.why: The standard shipping cost for Italy corrected from 9,90 to 12,50 EUR, on WhatsApp; 'spedizioni' is the existing category.

edited.subject: Re: Workshop
edited.body:

proposed.subject: Re: Biglietti da visita
proposed.body:
Gentile Sig. Bassi,
per 500 biglietti da visita il prezzo è di 45 EUR + IVA.
Cordiali saluti,
Lo staff della Tipografia Esempio

edited.subject: Re: Biglietti da visita
edited.body:
Gentile Sig. Bassi,
visto che è nostro cliente da tanti anni, per questa volta le facciamo 38 EUR + IVA per i 500 biglietti da visita.
Cordiali saluti,
Lo staff della Tipografia Esempio

cases.why: A one-off discount for a long-standing customer ('per questa volta'); the tool says a recipient-specific discount is not a standard fact, and recording 38 EUR would misprice every future offer.

proposed.subject: Re: White-label rates
proposed.body:

our white-label day rate is 700 EUR/day, VAT exlcuded.

Hello,
our white-label day rate is 700 EUR/day, VAT excluded.

Hi Priya,
your order of 40 display stands will ship on 16 October.
